coverage.summary: The AGA limits rent increases only for fully covered units. These are most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes whose current tenancy began before 1996, and rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually). Partially covered units have no rent control: new construction with a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, and certain HUD-related subsidized units. Exempt unit types fall outside the ordinance.
coverage.owner_conditions: Golden Duplex units are exempt. Units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant are exempt only if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started.
coverage.other_conditions: Single-family homes are fully covered only if the current tenancy began before 1996. The 2026 AGA does not apply to tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

result.notes:
Changes from the original record:
- requires_unknown_facts changed from true to false. The rule covers ordinary pre-1980 multifamily rental buildings. Exemptions that an address lookup cannot check (Golden Duplex, shared kitchen/bath, ADU, subsidy-based partial coverage, tenancy start dates) are listed in unverifiable_exemptions instead.
- supersedes_state_rule set to null. No document mentions the state rent cap (Civ. Code § 1947.12) or its relationship to the local ordinance, so the summary's statements about the state cap were removed.
- The Regulation 1148 notice and qualifying-condition requirement was removed from other_conditions. It describes landlord conduct, not coverage.

Open issue on the construction cutoff: the cutoff follows D009 (Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 means partially covered). D006 instead describes new construction as having 'a certificate of occupancy issued after 1980', and D009 labels fully covered units 'built before 1980'. The treatment of January–June 1980 should be verified against the ordinance text (BMC 13.76.050).
